dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: It's my very own fleet! It's just me right now, but one day, it'll grow into something big!

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: My Ma and Pa were both sailors in the fleet, but they were returned to the sea during a voyage, so Captain Beidou took me in...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: We have a saying here, it says "the new surpasses the old." Captain Beidou is the one who raised me, my fleet mustn't be an embarrassment to her!

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: I've always wanted to be a sailor myself, but the Captain's forbidden me to go out to sea, saying that it's too dangerous. So this time, I've secretly stowed aboard...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: I got an earful from Uncle Juza, but I got to go out to sea, and that makes me a sailor now!
